exposure: perineal ultrasonography measurements (hiatal area at rest, pelvic contraction, Valsalva; detrusor muscle thickness; bladder neck descent)
finding: Transperineal ultrasound measurements, including detrusor muscle thickness and hiatal area (HA) at rest, pelvic contraction, and Valsalva Manoeuvre, were significantly associated with various pelvic floor dysfunctions in pregnant women.
mod_finding: Delivery method was identified as a risk factor for pelvic floor dysfunctions in pregnancy.
birth_weight: mentioned as a risk factor for PFDs, but not as a characteristic of the cohort's babies' weights
gest_age: mentioned as 'gestational week' as a risk factor for PFDs, but not as a characteristic of the cohort's babies' gestational ages
